title: Banteay Kdei
visualBrief: Mapped main outer gallery and eastern hall/connector, four-court inner gallery and nine approximate tower stations, four inner cardinal cross-plan gatehouses, and four outer gateways. Give the actual outer eastern entrance its photographed face tower. Preserve open courtyards, standard terrain, independent native buildings and mapped gate spacing; no single solid compound extrusion. Ancient full spires, exact hidden interiors, extensive unmapped enclosure/landscape and a certified per-gate restoration/roof-survival inventory are not claimed.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID relation3045422 fixes the main101x45m gallery. Ten standard native building controls retain its outer courtyard, four inner courts, four inner cross-plan gatehouses and four widely separated outer gateways. Native +X east/+Z south; runtime heading0 with internal architectural angle -0.079425183341rad. The photographed face tower belongs to the outer eastern entrance about353m from the main group, not the inner east gate. Other gates' upper survival, doorway details and heights are approximate.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Three inspected ordinary pictures guide weathered block galleries, deep window recesses, true portal voids, narrow corbelled roof remnants, varied broken tiered prangs and the specific rounded face block at the eastern outer gateway. Main walls4.2m, roof5.6m, nine crown heights6.7–13.2m and eastern face gateway11.4m are picture-led estimates. Individual apsaras, inscriptions, exact collapse inventory, restored complete spires, furnished interiors and a certified pillar count are not claimed.

No ground or water cutout.
